scope: Separate diagnostic after PostgreSQL; preserves the original qualified matrix. No retroactive selection or replacement samples.

checkpoint_context.note: Periodic status covers the whole phase, not exact sysbench windows. Publication transitions are bracketed by status observations; they are not individual checkpoint durations.

engine_metadata.contract: FLUSH/FUA durable on local disk; S3 checkpoint asynchronous every 5 seconds, longer during backlog

limitations: Earlier reference and later control use an evolving fixture; temporal-order bias remains.
Process I/O snapshots bracket sysbench including setup/exit.
Peak RSS is a process-lifetime high water, not a sample-only maximum.
preconditioning_limitations: The reference read_write/write_only samples followed three read_only measurements; this predeclared control measures only read_write/write_only after the same 60-second MySQL warmup.
The fixture evolves between the earlier reference and this later control; prior writes, binlog expiration and operating-system caches are not reset.
Only the engine-option delta is strictly isolated. This one-pass diagnostic does not establish causality independently of workload history and temporal order.
